items.title: Mrs. Charlotte Botney and Mrs. Bertha George McCullum Interview, 1960-10-16
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] We stayed with Johnny St. Cyr. Remember, he used to live not far from here.

ctx.x: We were there two years ago.
We went to two years ago. We stayed with Johnny St. Cyr. Remember, he used to live not far from here.
Yeah. The guitarist there is here. He had a symphony orchestra out in Hollywood.
